description: HSP2, pronounced HSP-squared, is RESPEC's Python port of the Hydrological Simulation Program FORTRAN watershed model. It contains hydrology and detailed water-quality modules, conversion tools for legacy WDM and UCI files, and a newer input/output abstraction for model coupling. Inputs can be converted to HDF5; outputs are simulated watershed responses available through Python or a command-line driver. Geographic coverage follows the configured watershed, and temporal coverage follows the supplied meteorological and management series. Source is free under AGPL-3.0, with PyPI packages and Windows executables. A limitation is that specialty-module support is still being developed and the input/output interface is in transition. The model supports water-supply, drainage and pollution-management simulations. EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) is a related urban-water model. The repository recommends Python 3.10 and includes HSPF comparison cases, which were not run here.
inputs: Legacy WDM/UCI or HDF5 model input
